## Evidence checklist

- [ ] I recorded source provenance for third-party content, including an immutable Git revision and source path.
- [ ] I recorded the applicable license and preserved third-party package contents.
- [ ] I added or updated positive and negative trigger cases when requesting certification.
- [ ] I inspected added or changed scripts, instructions, links, and assets before execution.
- [ ] I ran `npm run catalog:build` and included the resulting generated artifacts when they changed.
- [ ] I ran `npm run validate`, `npm run catalog:check`, and `npm run test:unit`.
- [ ] Any certification claim is supported by the evidence in this pull request; community content is not described as KuudoAI-certified.
